notes: «أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation; «عن أخيه موسى ابن جعفر» is one link, the name alone.
«أحمد بن (ي‍) زيد» is copied with its stray characters as the text has them.
The second explanation («قال علي بن جعفر: فسألته ... فقال») is the same Imam's answer, not a second isnad; the last link stays موسى ابن جعفر.
